title: Privacy Policy
description: How Ohomi handles your data and protects your privacy

sections.title: Information We Do Not Collect
sections.content: We do not collect any personally identifiable information (such as your name, email address, phone number, precise location information) from App users.

sections.title: Information We May Collect (Non-Personal)
sections.content: We may collect non-personal information about your App usage to improve your experience and performance:

subsections.title: Usage Data
subsections.content: Information about how you interact with the App (e.g., features used, duration of use). This data helps us understand and improve the App.

subsections.title: Technical Data
subsections.content: Information about your device (e.g., device type, operating system, App version). This data helps us ensure the App functions well across various devices.

sections.title: How We Use Information
sections.content: The non-personal information collected is used solely for the following purposes:

subsections.title: App Improvement
subsections.content: Analyzing data to enhance the App's quality and features.

subsections.title: Maintenance and Optimization
subsections.content: Troubleshooting and ensuring the App operates stably.

subsections.title: Internal Research
subsections.content: Conducting anonymous analysis to understand user behavior and general trends.

sections.title: Information Sharing
sections.content: We do not share any personal information with any third parties. Non-personal information may be shared in an aggregated and anonymous form (which cannot be used to personally identify you) with analytics partners or service providers to assist in analyzing and improving the App.

sections.title: Information Security
sections.content: We implement reasonable security measures to protect the information collected. However, no system is entirely secure.

sections.title: Changes to This Privacy Policy
sections.content: We may update this Policy. Any changes will be posted on this page. Your continued use of the App after changes are posted constitutes your acceptance of those changes.
